evidence.name: Screen field: Wording on the buy button
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Wording on the buy button" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Wording on the buy button
sections.description: The text on your paywall's purchase button (default 'Subscribe Now'). This is the most important call to action in the whole funnel, so make it clear and benefit-led, such as 'Start My Free Trial' or 'Unlock Full Access'. If you run multiple languages, this wording is saved per language, so translate it for each.
